notes:
- Suggested by Ghostlex!
- A Redstone tier: R1 Architect for simple redstone, R2 Builder for easy farms, R3 Redstoner for simple traps and advanced farms. R4 Master trapper is the level four rank on top.
- A Special category beside the ranks: Media for content creators and Staff. A special is a mark after your name rather than a word in front of it, so you can hold one alongside your rank, and it can be switched off in the settings.
- Streamer mode: the coordinate readout shows somewhere else entirely, so a stream never gives your base away. The numbers still move the way real ones do.
- Chat bubbles: what a player said appears with their name, and whoever is talking right now is marked, so a busy server reads at a glance.
- A crosshair of your own, on its own page: four shapes, the length, the gap, the thickness, eight colours and a hit marker, with the real thing drawn next to the settings.
- Presets: save every switch and every panel's place under a name and put it back on with one press.
- The installed mods tab has a filter, so a folder of eighty jars is no longer a scroll hunt.
- The ARRANGE HUD button works. The settings list ran fourteen pixels under its own footer, so a card nobody could see was swallowing the press and quietly flipping a setting instead.

Suggested by Ghostlex
